tagline: Link Figma design deliverables directly to project tasks in Asana
metaTitle: Asana + Figma Integration: Figma Files on Asana Tasks
metaDescription: Attach Figma files to Asana tasks and get notified when designs are ready. GAIA tracks design approval status. See the setup steps.
intro:
Design and project management workflows are tightly coupled but typically tracked in separate tools. Designers work in Figma while project managers track deliverables in Asana, and the handoff between them involves manual link sharing, copy-pasted feedback, and status updates communicated through Slack threads or email chains.

GAIA connects the two so design progress and project timelines stay synchronized. When a designer marks a file ready for review, GAIA can automatically update the linked task and notify the relevant stakeholders. When a task enters the design phase, GAIA can create a file stub and link it back to the task so there is always a single source of truth for design deliverables.

This integration reduces coordination overhead between design and product teams, accelerates feedback loops, and ensures that design handoffs happen at the right stage of the project rather than after deadlines have already slipped.

useCases.title: Auto-attach Figma files to tasks
useCases.description: When a new file is created for a project, GAIA automatically attaches the link to the corresponding task so team members always know where to find the latest design assets.

useCases.title: Design-ready notifications in Asana
useCases.description: When a designer updates a file to a Ready for Review status, GAIA updates the linked task's stage and notifies the assigned reviewer so feedback begins without a separate Slack message.

useCases.title: Track design approval status
useCases.description: GAIA monitors comment activity on the design files and reflects approval or revision requests as task comments, giving project managers a complete view of the design review lifecycle within their existing tool.

useCases.title: Trigger design tasks from Asana milestones
useCases.description: When a milestone is reached, such as a feature spec being approved, GAIA creates the corresponding design task in the project and initializes a design file, ensuring design work begins at the right moment.

useCases.title: Design handoff to development
useCases.description: When a design is marked approved, GAIA transitions the task to a development-ready section and notifies the engineering assignee with the design link, making handoffs automatic and traceable.

howItWorks.step: Connect Asana and Figma to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA to access your task workspace and design account. Configure which projects correspond to which design teams or design projects.

howItWorks.step: Map design stages to task sections
howItWorks.description: Define how file statuses, In Progress, Ready for Review, Approved, map to task sections or custom fields so each status change updates the task automatically.

howItWorks.step: GAIA links design and project work
howItWorks.description: GAIA monitors both tools and propagates status changes, file links, and notifications in real time, so design progress is always visible within the project.

faqs.question: Can GAIA attach specific frames rather than entire files?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can configure GAIA to attach specific frame or component links to tasks, making it easier for reviewers to navigate directly to the relevant part of a complex design file.

faqs.question: Does GAIA sync Figma comments to Asana?
faqs.answer: GAIA can summarize comment threads and post them as task comments, giving project managers visibility into design feedback without requiring an account in the design tool.

faqs.question: What happens when a design file is updated after approval?
faqs.answer: GAIA can detect edits to the file after approval and reopen the review task or notify the team, ensuring that post-approval changes are not silently deployed without another review cycle.
